description: Phase FRP-7 V1.5 wall-clock pin (supplement §14.1 V1.5 column). Asserts the L3 floating-IP fast path completes end-to-end in < 15 seconds. Drives Provider.UnassignFloatingIP + AssignFloatingIP against a Hetzner mock; the soak-driver records the synthetic-clock wall-clock and fails the day if the budget breaks. The wall-clock pin matches the publisher/deploy/rotation/executor.go ErrL3WallClockBudget constant (15 * time.Second). Recovery action on miss: the supplement §14.1 'V2 in-box mgmt API' will bring L3 to ~5 s once FRP-10 lands; until then 15 s is the V1.5 ship invariant.
